items.title: Substitute exercise from a similar-muscle picker during an active session (instead of skipping + adding)
steps: Start an active session.
On any exercise card, tap the SUBSTITUTE (swap) action.
Verify the picker is NEVER empty - it lists the full exercise library, with the best same-muscle matches grouped under a SUGGESTED header first (e.g. Face Pulls surfaces shoulder/back picks).
Type in the 'Search all exercises' box and verify the list filters by name or muscle across the WHOLE library, not just same-muscle picks.
Verify candidates needing gear you don't own show a 'NEEDS X' flag (equipment is a ranking hint, not a hard filter).
Tap + JUST TODAY and verify the swap is session-only; tap an alternate's REPLACE and verify it also updates the saved routine for future sessions.
Pick an exercise whose card id is a custom/planner instance (not a library id) and verify the picker still populates the full library rather than the old empty 'No same-muscle alternates' message.
items.notes:
[2026-06-08] SUGGESTION QUALITY. @maaiz: Face Pulls picker surfaced chest exercises at the top. Cause: the session card's instance id didn't resolve via getExerciseById AND the plural name 'Face Pulls' didn't match library 'Face Pull', so rankExercisesForSwap had no target muscles and returned the library in default (chest-first) order. Fix: new resolveExercise(id,name) - id first, then a normalized plural/punct-tolerant name match - so the target resolves; ranking now weights by COUNT of shared primary muscles (sharedPrimary*60) so Rear Delt Fly (shoulders+back, same as Face Pull) leads over single-muscle matches like Lateral Raise. Audit: 132/132 library names round-trip; 0 exercises with an empty same-muscle pool; plurals resolve. (qa: session-substitute-exercise)

[2026-06-08] REWORK. @maaiz: the substitute picker still came up empty for some exercises (e.g. Face Pulls). The prior ignoreEquipment fix missed the real cause - the active-session card passes its instance id, which for some entries doesn't resolve via getExerciseById, so suggestSubstitutions returned []. Per @maaiz 'they should be able to substitute with ANY exercise, suggestions first', the user-mode pool now comes from rankExercisesForSwap() which returns the ENTIRE library (never empty), ranked: same primary muscle (+100) then secondary overlap, owned-equipment a minor tiebreak (+5). The modal gained a search box + a SUGGESTED group (same-muscle, top 6) above an ALL EXERCISES list. Robust when the target id doesn't resolve (full library still shows, minus the SUGGESTED group). JUST TODAY / REPLACE semantics unchanged. (qa: session-substitute-exercise)

[2026-06-08] FIXED. @maaiz reported the SWAP picker just showed 'No same-muscle alternates in the library' (e.g. Face Pulls) instead of choices. Root cause: despite the notes/comment claiming user-mode 'ignores the equipment-missing filter', suggestSubstitutions still hard-filtered by owned equipment, so a user with little gear got an empty pool. Added an `{ ignoreEquipment }` option (set in user mode) so the full same-muscle pool surfaces; equipment is now a ranking signal (owned gear scores +10 → listed first) rather than a hard filter, and the modal flags candidates needing gear the user doesn't own with a 'NEEDS X' badge. Auto mode (can't-do-today) still hard-filters. (qa: session-substitute-exercise)

[2026-05-26] SHIPPED: new ⇄ SWAP button on every trackable exercise card in active session (next to EDIT). Opens the subModal in 'user' mode (new field on subModal state) which: (a) bumps suggestions to 8 same-primary-muscle picks, (b) ignores the equipment-missing filter so any same-muscle exercise can be chosen, (c) renders per-candidate + JUST TODAY / ↻ REPLACE buttons. JUST TODAY mutates activeDay only. REPLACE additionally PUTs /api/plan + patches customPlan so the swap sticks across future sessions of this day (per user choice 'Ask each time'). Confirms before swapping if any sets are already logged for the original exercise — logged sets are preserved under the original exercise id in session history. Source: @maaiz 'Introduce a substitute function for active sessions instead of manually skipping or adding a new exercise'.

[2026-05-26] OPEN. @maaiz: 'Introduce a substitute function for active sessions instead of manually skipping or adding a new exercise, can choose to substitute the exercise from a selection of exercises that are targeting similar muscle areas and identify the alternate exercise down that split'. Punted from 2026-05-26 deploy — needs the muscle-overlap query + the one-off-vs-permanent UX call.

items.notes:
[2026-05-26] CORRECTED LOGIC: the `retested` server flag was hiding parent comments the moment ANY retest existed (including ⟲ NEEDS RETEST and ✗ STILL BROKEN). That made marking RETEST pointless — the item vanished from the user's patches-to-retest list with no way back. Now `retested` only flips true for ✓ WORKS NOW (passing) verdicts. Per @maaiz: 'You said again retest wouldn't surface again. What's the point of marking it for retest then???'. NEEDS RETEST and STILL BROKEN verdicts keep the parent visible — they're explicit asks to keep the item in the queue.

[2026-05-26] /api/qa/comments/mine GET filters RETEST comments by status: keeps `failing` / `regression-retest` (still needs attention from Claude → next pass should see them), hides `passing` (user said works now → done). Steps updated to reflect this semantic. Per @maaiz clarification 'if I select retest it means it needs attention by you then test again. If I said it works now, that's when we don't need to circle back to it later after a qa process'.

[2026-05-26] /api/qa/comments/mine GET now filters out comments whose note matches `[🔄 RETEST ...]`. These are user VERDICTS on previously-shipped patches, not bug reports. When marked processed during a qa-pass batch, the list was surfacing them back asking the user to retest their own retest. Per @maaiz: 'This should not come back to my your patches to test unless it's reported broken again'.
